name: claudui
description: An Electron application with React and TypeScript
author: Daniel Liu <wellofspirit@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run ensure-cli && npm run ensure-opencode && npm run ensure-pi && electron-vite build
scripts.ensure-cli: node scripts/extract-cli.mjs && node patch/apply-all.mjs && node scripts/rebundle-cli.mjs
scripts.update-cli: node scripts/extract-cli.mjs --force && node patch/apply-all.mjs && node scripts/rebundle-cli.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron-builder install-app-deps && npm run ensure-cli && npm run ensure-opencode && npm run ensure-pi
scripts.build:unpack: npm run build && npm run build:web && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run build:web && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.build:mac: npm run ensure-cli && npm run ensure-opencode && npm run ensure-pi && electron-vite build && vite build --config vite.web.config.ts && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --dir && codesign --force --deep --sign "${MAC_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}" dist/mac-arm64/ClaudeUI.app && xattr -cr dist/mac-arm64/ClaudeUI.app
scripts.build:linux: npm run ensure-cli && npm run ensure-opencode && npm run ensure-pi && electron-vite build && vite build --config vite.web.config.ts && electron-builder --linux
scripts.test:ci: vitest run --project unit --project component --project e2e --project git

_comment_dependencies: Only packages imported by src/main or src/preload belong here. electron-vite's externalizeDepsPlugin externalizes exactly the `dependencies` keys, so a main-process import that lives in devDependencies gets inline-bundled instead. Renderer/web-only packages are bundled by vite and must stay in devDependencies so electron-builder prunes them from the shipped node_modules.
